summary.bn: দুটো বাইনারি কাউন্টার: ক্লকের প্রতি নামতি ধারে এক করে বাড়ে, ০ থেকে ১৫
summary.en: Two binary counters: each counts up by one on every falling edge of its clock, 0 to 15

simplified: Each counter answers at once: the few nanoseconds a real one takes, and the ripple from one bit to the next, are left out.
It counts when its clock goes from HIGH to LOW. MR HIGH holds the counter at 0 at once, whatever the clock does.
Without power it forgets its count and starts at 0. A real chip may start anywhere until it is reset.

An input is HIGH above 70 % of the supply and LOW below 30 %; in between it keeps its last level. An output is the supply or ground through about 50 Ω. These are typical datasheet figures, not measured.
It is placed across the centre gap with pin 1 at the bottom left, and cannot be turned round.
